videos.why: The topic with the biggest proven demand (a 2.4M-view Catacombs breakout on an 824-sub channel). Its strangest layer, a wall of skulls, lands at 5 s, and the payoff is 6M people. Moved well above rank's 5.0, which has no data yet for the straight-down shape.
strengths: Wall of skulls and a spiral stair: pictures people share
Payoff figure (6M people) counted up in the bone room
risks: 25 s, at the top of the band
The layers come from different parts of Paris (said in the description)

videos.why: A metro under a working river, with a 3.7M-view reference. Trains move in every layer and the camera rides back up to the boats on 'Under the river'. It ranks below Paris because it is a local topic and its payoff (520 m under the water) is a length, not a shock.
strengths: Bridge and boats recognisable in frame 1
Trains, a fan and workers moving in every layer
risks: Howrah depth said as 'about' (sources range 30-35 m)

videos.why: A strong mystery hook (something Roman buried under the Vatican's biggest church) and a close-up payoff on the grave shrine. Its reference demand is borrowed from the format, not the topic.
strengths: Curiosity hook that holds the answer back
Figures carved on the room walls
risks: Warm palette, quieter motion than the transit dives

videos.why: World-famous subject, but a foundation has no movement and the payoff (110,000 tonnes) is abstract.
